control_set.name: car16
control_set.description: 16 headings, point-sized car-like agent with minimum turning radius 2 cells. Cubic Hermite primitives between lattice states, up to 24 per heading before removing primitives that other primitives reproduce. Traces are supercovers (corner crossings mark both side cells). Cost is curve length.

maps.note: MovingAI Baldur's Gate II indoor map (AR0700SR).
